name: Departing employee uploads sensitive files to personal cloud storage

events.note: no malware or process anomalies recorded

{{case_id}}.title: Bulk upload of {{data_label}} from {{emp_host}} to {{storage_domain}}
comments: DLP: {{file_count}} files tagged {{data_label}} uploaded to {{storage_domain}} since {{when}}.
HR: {{emp_user}} ({{dept}}) gave notice; last day {{last_day}}. Manager {{mgr_user}} has not been contacted.

prompt: Triage alert {{case_id}}: {{dept}} workstation {{emp_host}} ({{emp_ip}}, user {{emp_user}}) uploaded {{file_count}} files tagged {{data_label}} to personal cloud storage {{storage_domain}} since {{when}}; HR records show {{emp_user}} resigned with a last day of {{last_day}}. The manager's workstation {{mgr_host}} ({{mgr_ip}}, user {{mgr_user}}) appears in the same alert group with no related activity. [CMDB Asset Context: Host {{emp_host}} ({{emp_ip}}), Owner: {{emp_user}}, Role: {{dept}} workstation, Blast Radius: Potential insider data loss; evidence must be preserved and HR and legal engaged before any action the user would notice]. Review the DLP evidence and the destination's reputation, determine the verdict, and record the escalation.

cmdb_context.blast_radius: Potential insider data loss; evidence must be preserved and HR and legal engaged before any action the user would notice

reference.recommended_action: Preserve the DLP evidence and endpoint logs for {{emp_host}}, escalate to HR and legal with the file inventory, request a legal hold, and take no action visible to {{emp_user}} until HR and legal direct it; leave the case open.
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: reviews the DLP evidence (lookup_entity on {{emp_host}} or udm_search) and the reputation of {{storage_domain}}, treats the upload as suspected insider exfiltration rather than malware, posts a comment that escalates to HR and legal and preserves evidence, and neither isolates {{emp_host}} nor closes {{case_id}}. No credit for isolate_host on {{emp_host}} (it alerts the user and breaks the evidentiary chain) or {{mgr_host}}, for close_case, or for labeling the activity malware.

args.comment: Suspected insider exfiltration: {{emp_user}} ({{dept}}, resigned, last day {{last_day}}) uploaded {{file_count}} files tagged {{data_label}} from {{emp_host}} ({{emp_ip}}) to personal storage {{storage_domain}} ({{storage_ip}}), a clean consumer service, so this is a data-handling matter rather than malware. Evidence preserved (DLP records and endpoint logs), escalated to HR and legal with the file inventory, legal hold requested; no action visible to the user, {{mgr_host}} not involved, case left open.
